Track record (dir_accuracy 0.534 over n=73) confirms calls are near coin-flip on direction, so conviction defaults low.
emerging_watch: Watching Gold Miners (GDX) leadership versus AI Infrastructure: if Gold Miners' rank crosses above AI Infrastructure's rank while keeping breadth > 0.7, that would confirm a rotation toward the non-crowded mining complex. Retire the watch if GDX breadth drops below 0.5 or crowding_z rises above 1.0.

theses.subject: Gold Miners
theses.thesis: Gold Miners (GDX) show the healthiest non-crowded trend structure among eligible themes: breadth 0.917 (nearly all constituents confirming), crowding_z 0.04 (no extension), durability_bar 0.67 (one of the highest on the board), and eligible=true. Unlike the crowded leader, this theme is in a confirmed uptrend without reflexivity risk, making it a cleaner trend-gate-compatible carry candidate.
evidence: breadth 0.917 — highest of all eligible themes
theses.dissent: Gold miners are a mean-reverting, rate-sensitive complex; if real yields rise or USD strengthens, the trend can break quickly despite healthy breadth today — GDX has a long history of sharp 20% drawdowns that breadth does not pre-empt.

falsifier.text: GDX trades below its own 50-day moving average and underperforms SPY by 5% before the check-by date

theses.subject: AI Infrastructure
theses.thesis: AI Infrastructure is the challenger in the rotation radar (score 1.705, margin to leader only 0.237) with non-crowded texture (crowding_z 0.9, crowded=false) and moderate breadth (0.167). Its durability_bar (0.53) is adequate and it holds a top-2 rank without the extension flag on the leader. This is a supported trend, not a crowding fade.
evidence: rank 2, challenger to leader with narrow 0.237 margin
theses.dissent: AI Infrastructure shares the SMH proxy with the crowded Memory leader, so a Memory de-rating drags the entire semiconductor complex down together — this is not diversifying exposure, and breadth 0.167 is low, meaning leadership is concentrated in few names.

falsifier.text: SMH lags SPY by 5% while Memory/HBM leadership margin widens beyond 0.5 before the check-by date

theses.subject: Memory, HBM & Storage
theses.thesis: Memory/HBM is the crowded leader (crowding_z 1.56, crowded=true, r10 -0.0073, val_state diverging) with zero breadth (0.0) and the LOWEST durability_bar in the top ranks (0.5). Per guardrails, this is not a short or fade — but it is precisely the theme to AVOID adding to: extension + zero breadth + diverging val_state marks a leader where entry risk is high and crowding only down-sizes, never buys.
theses.dissent: Memory/HBM is a genuine fundamental upcycle with hard supply-demand drivers (HBM sold out through 2027); crowding flags have historically marked tops only at TRUE one-narrative extremes, and this is not one_narrative (breadth_of_rotation is broad), so the leader may keep leading.

falsifier.text: Memory/HBM breadth rises above 0.4 AND crowding_z falls below 1.0 before the check-by date, restoring constructive texture

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
